production.note: US model years. First: BMW NA says both models will 'arrive in US showrooms in the Spring of 2015' as 2015 models. BMW NA published a 2017 X5 M technical data sheet (bmw-us-2017-x5m-techdata). Last: KBB lists a 2018 X5 M at 567 hp (kbb-x5m-2018-specs); the next X5 M was 'Fully redesigned for 2020' and 'Kicks off the third X5 M generation' (edmunds-x5m-2020). No opened BMW page says in so many words that 2018 was the last model year.

body.note: 'No of Doors / Seats / 5 / 5'; BMW calls it a Sports Activity Vehicle. The X6 M is a separate model.

aspiration.note: 'Charging Type / Charging Technique M Twin PowerTurbo / Twin Scroll-Twin Turbo'

fuel.note: Gasoline V8, as described in the release.

transmission.note: 'eight-speed M Steptronic transmission with Drivelogic' (torque-converter automatic, 'M 8HP75')

powerHp.note: Quote: "Engine power / at rpm hp @ rpm 567 / 6000-6500". Release: "567 hp between 6,000 and 6,500 rpm". BMW NA's 2017 sheet (bmw-us-2017-x5m-techdata): "Engine power hp@rpm 567@6000-6500".

weightLb.note: US curb weight, 2015 model, the only transmission. Quote: "Curb weight (US) Kg / lbs 2386 / 5260". BMW NA's 2017 sheet gives the same: "US Curb weight lbs 5260".
